scope: Fresh per-trial Python runner/bridge + Rust, macOS ps RSS, decimal MB. Browser/cloud weights/outer orchestrator excluded. Shared-page dedup unverified. 100 ms nominal polling cannot establish true peak or observe a shorter-lived Rust process. First sample is an observed baseline proxy, not pre-start physical commit.
